recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-shot portrait of a female artist in edgy attire, set against a neutral gradient background with heavy, distressed sans-serif typography layered across the midsection.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a radial spotlight background
Text layered both behind and in front of the subject's torso
High contrast between black leather textures and warm skin tones
Distressed, weathered text texture mirroring the 'rock' aesthetic
coreInvariants: Black studded leather jacket and accessories
Muted gold or tan color for primary typography
Heavy drop shadow on text to create depth

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, waist-up, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The artist's face and the large-scale primary text across the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the large name text, then to the smaller subtitle on the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space on the left and right sides of the head, narrowing towards the bottom as the subject fills the width.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral greys and blacks (background and clothing).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm auburn hair and skin tones against the cool background.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the central light and dark edges.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to earth tones and greyscale

letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges simulating stamped or weathered paint
characterSpecificRedesigns: Distressed interior texture within the glyph fills

composition.overlap: behind arms, in front of torso

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and weight contrast within the same distressed typeface family.
graphicDevices: Layered masking to place text behind foreground elements

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight and presence.
Provides the correct verticality and condensed feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with auburn hair wearing a black studded leather jacket and leather pants, centered against a grey radial gradient background with a spotlight effect behind her head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-condensed, distressed tan-colored uppercase text across the center. Mask the text so it appears behind the jacket sleeves but in front of the torso. Add a smaller subtitle in the same style at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the text properly masked behind the arms?
Does the text have a visible weathered/grunge texture?
Is the background a smooth radial gradient?
Is the lighting high-contrast on the leather texture?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic leather specular highlights
Ensure text drop shadow is consistent with lighting
Verify the 'weathered' effect doesn't make text unreadable
Confirm the subject's pose is centered and balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Radial Gradient + Layered Distressed Condensed Typography = Edgy Pop-Rock Cover
